issues.title: Rejecting 'Unlock tokens and wrap' leaves the button stuck on 'Unlock tokens and wrap'
issues.summary: After rejecting the wallet request the page kept a disabled 'Unlock tokens and wrap' button, so the user can't try again without reloading.
stepsToReproduce: Reject the flow's main request in the wallet (error 4001).
issues.expected: Re-enable the button and show what happened.
issues.actual: The 'Unlock tokens and wrap' button is still disabled 2s later.
